integrity: The arguments and cited source comparisons are disclosed; symbolic sample tests corroborate but do not replace proofs. Independent validation has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns the three-dimensional polynomial map, not its four-dimensional memristive extension; it classifies primitive period two and strict local exponential attraction, not higher periods, basin size, or nonlinear dynamics at neutral multipliers. Historical priority is a best-knowledge judgment.
title: Complete prime-two orbit census and sharp sink window for a three-dimensional parabolic map
